issues.description: The problem statement lists simulate_msd_two_rounds with a batch_size default of 1000000.0 (a float), but both the template and the solution define the parameter as an int with default 1000000. This inconsistency in the parameter type/default may confuse students about the expected type (float vs int) for batch_size.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the batch_size parameter consistent across artifacts. Prefer using an integer type for batch sizes. Update the problem statement to declare simulate_msd_two_rounds(..., batch_size: int = 1000000) (or change template/solution to use a float consistently) so all three artifacts agree.
